single_change: rule-qualified anchor retained across GNSS outage/reacquisition
fixed_r02_parameters: selected C9: W5s, short score4, good2s; same Q/R, Huber, wait2s/recovery15s/protection15, health and availability
anchor_qualification: only previously admitted NORMAL observations with available healthy local evidence, passing short score and nominal NIS<=16.266236 continuously for declared duration; retain latest such raw GNSS observation with its full receiver covariance, no independent-sample averaging
anchor_scope: activate held anchor at a true GNSS gap; do not refresh during outage, isolation or recovery; anchor veto adds to same short-window qualification, never replaces a position measurement or updates from an old GNSS twice
normalization: R_current_xy+R_anchor_xy+common_Q_time_distance_growth*declared_multiplier; engineering uncertainty, no calibrated integrity probability
unavailable_rule: same r02 mature fallback when local health is unavailable; missing rule-qualified anchor leaves short-window behavior with an explicit missing-anchor diagnostic
identifiability_limit: sufficient local-motion drift and a stable GNSS bias can generate identical observations; never claim guaranteed identification or elimination of arbitrary persistent offsets
